decisions.reason: The responsive template is cheap to maintain and helps agencies start projects, though templates age quickly and it has not been seen on the website since 2018, so a cleanup remains a real possibility.
Premium support builds on the firm's core strength of round-the-clock expert service and brings recurring extra revenue from agencies.
The version management tool fits the strategy of reducing developers' recurring operational work and is part of the platform's integrated toolset.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship product line and central to the firm's agency-focused direction.
